title: Unused client settings imports make Ruff fail
reasoning: Both imported symbols are unused in this file. `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/client.py` reports F401 for `ClientSettingsRead` and `ClientSettingsUpdate`, so the configured lint command will fail before release or CI completion.
reproduction: Run `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/client.py`; Ruff reports two F401 unused-import errors on line 10.
recommendation: Remove the unused `ClientSettingsRead` and `ClientSettingsUpdate` import line.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Runtime tests do not exercise static lint failures, and the feature lists no linked tests.
